description:
FILED s543f (Opus 5.5, 2026-11-21), PPI batch 11 member 1 (§11 / §71).

    $_ = "x"; print STDOUT /x/, "\n";
      perl: 1            PCL: statement dropped ("Handle single node of unknown type")

After PCL's PPI group BE (§71) a `/` after a BUILTIN that takes an operand is a match on the branch, but a bareword FILEHANDLE after print is a user's word to PPI (`STDOUT` is not a keyword), so the `/` stays an Operator -- the user half of §11, which `Pl::Parser2::_repair_word_match` owns.  The repair declines because it asks `_word_is_term`, whose ALL-CAPS guess reads `STDOUT` as a constant.  `_repair_word_x_call` already has the fix shape for the sibling `print STDOUT x()`: it asks `_word_is_declared_term` (no ALL-CAPS guess), because after a print-family keyword an undeclared ALL-CAPS word is a handle, not an operand.  The same predicate split applies here, keyed on the word after print / printf / say (not every ALL-CAPS word: `FOO / 2` with an imported constant must keep dividing).

Same on main ffc7eb72 (base drops too).  Probe: scratch/s543f/p1/s28.pl in the s543f worktree.
BAR: `print STDOUT /x/`, `print STDERR /x/ ? 1 : 0`, `printf STDOUT /x/ ? "y" : "n"` vs perl; controls `use constant FOO => 4; print FOO / 2`, `print STDOUT 4 / 2`; corpus-diff + the wide A/B; a guard row beside #872's.


=== DONE (s543i) -- PCL's side (PPI's tokens are right for what PPI can know: the handle is a user's word) ===
perl (toke.c): a bareword right after a list operator that no declaration makes a sub is an indirect object, and after it perl expects a TERM -- so `print STDOUT /x/` prints a match; a DECLARED constant there is a call (`use constant FOO => 4; print FOO / 2` divides).  The lowering already asked exactly that for `print NAME LIST` (PExpr: handle shape or a registered handle, unless a zero-arg prototype makes it a term); _repair_word_match asked _word_is_term, whose ALL-CAPS guess reads STDOUT as a constant.  ONE predicate now: Pl::Environment::print_slot_handle($name, $is_declared_term) -- PExpr's print-filehandle test calls it (emission identical) and _repair_word_match asks it for the word right after print / printf / say (with _word_is_declared_term: the repairs run before the document's `use constant` reaches the Environment).
Probes perl -> base -> tree (scratch/s543i/probes/m4.txt, 19 rows): 7 base drops / dies -> tree = perl (`print STDOUT /x/`, `print STDERR /x/ ? 1 : 0`, `printf STDOUT /x/ ? ...`, `say STDOUT /x/`, `print STDOUT /b/g ? ...` (an "Illegal division by zero" on main), `print OUT /x/` after open, `print STDOUT /(x)(x)/`); controls = perl on both (`print FOO / 2` with a constant, `print STDOUT 4 / 2`, `print $fh /q/`, `print {*STDOUT} /x/`, `print main::STDOUT /x/`, `ok /a/`, `split /\//`, `print STDOUT $t / $t`).  LEFT, LOUD on base and tree: `print STDOUT /;/` (the `;` inside the pattern ends PPI's statement before the repair's close scan -- #2774's derail), and #2774's two rows.
Guard: Pl/t/transpile-test-10.t "#5231: /re/ after print STDOUT / printf STDOUT / an opened handle is a MATCH" (fails on main).
